objective: Complete standalone Rust recreation of supplied Angry Birds Epic with easier earned gold and every bundled hat purchasable for gold
verified_platforms: macOS arm64 release executable and native UI/save checks (including native music backend checks)

user_overrides.hat_purchases: Every one of the 116 bundled player class skins is sold for earned gold, without premium/event/date restrictions

Eight regressions include enemy Spectators, unsupported wet condition exclusion and Bard-to-Frost-Savage actions. Native UI compares normal/boosted damage. Current integer rounding/curse classification is provisional; native callbacks and other status conditions need recovery. No save-format change.
